title: The occurrence, characteristics and control of ribavirin and chloroquine phosphate in the aquatic environment: a review
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW00558A, Critical Review
Xicheng Wang, Zhangbin Pan, Zhenqi Du, Wuchang Song, Congcong Li, Rong Xiao, Ruibao Jia
Ribavirin (RBV) and chloroquine phosphate (CQP) are widely used antiviral drugs, and have raised considerable concern due to their ubiquitous nature, persistence, bioaccumulation, and high toxicity.
